Best,

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@acornhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability handoff + runbook request

Thanks Marissa / Priya — taking the alert taxonomy. A couple of engineering constraints and proposals up front: 

1) PagerDuty integration: we can map high-priority (P0/P1) alerts to the SRE rotation and put medium-priority (P2) into a shared Ops queue. We need the PagerDuty service API key and the on-call schedule name to finalize the mapping.
2) Alert noise minimization: recommend a 3-stage gating for the alert rule: (a) rolling-window error spike (5m) + (b) sustained token-cost increase (10m) OR (c) quality-regression signal from eval hooks. We'll provide thresholds but need historical metrics to tune.
3) Trace hooks: instrument the model call entry, KV cache hits, and policy fallback points. Please confirm which SDK/version you are on; we have slight span name differences between v2.0 and v2.1.

I attached a CSV with the first pass taxonomy (proposed_alert_taxonomy.csv). I will follow up with a sample PagerDuty mapping and sample alert expressions tomorrow AM.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Lead Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: proposed_alert_taxonomy.csv (text/csv, 8KB)

From: Priya Nair <ops@acornhealth.com>

Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability handoff + runbook request

Connor — thanks. We are on the 2.0 SDK for now but plan to upgrade next month; that should be fine. PagerDuty: I can provide the API key and schedule name off-band (security). For historical metrics, I just shared a CloudWatch export to your SRE alias; should be visible as "acorn-cw-export-aug03".

A couple clarifying points:
- For quality regressions, we have an ML-eval job that compares recent outputs against golden prompts on a daily cadence; if the score drops >6 points we want to trigger a P1.
- For cost anomalies, we want Ops to be notified (P2) and only page SRE if cost is >30% above baseline for 1 hour.

If you can include sample Grafana JSON for the latency + token-cost panels that would speed our onboarding.

Priya
Priya Nair
VP, Operations — Acorn Health
